entities.summary: Mike Condon is an American former professional ice hockey goaltender who currently serves as a volunteer assistant goalie coach at Northeastern University. Originally undrafted by teams in the National Hockey League (NHL), Condon has played for the Montreal Canadiens, Pittsburgh Penguins and Ottawa Senators.
